newsitem.title: UK: Pru Q1 new business shows double-digit gain.
newsitem.headline: Pru Q1 new business shows double-digit gain.

text.p: British life insurance group Prudential Corp Plc on Thursday announced healthy growth in sales of life, pension and investment products in the first three months of 1997.
First quarter single premium sales rose 22 percent to 1.76 billion pounds ($2.9 billion) worldwide, while regular premium sales were 17 percent higher at 130 million pounds.
Pru chief executive Sir Peter Davis described the sales figures as "very encouraging".
"We are particularly pleased that the sales momentum we built up in 1996 has continued into 1997," he added.
In Britain, regular premiums rose 18 percent to 84 million pounds and single premium sales rose to 885 million from 866 million pounds a year earlier.
Sales at the Pru's American subsidiary Jackson National Life, increased by 79 percent to $1.1 billion, boosted by the success of its recently expanded product range.
Single premium sales in Asia more than doubled to 49 million pounds while regular premium sales rose 28 percent to 23 million pounds.
